item.title: Winter Solstice and New Year Journal: 7 Quiet Days Inspired by Japan
item.description: A printable winter solstice and New Year reflection journal: seven quiet days from tōji, the winter solstice, to kakizome, the first writing of the new year. Each day has a Japanese custom, a classic haiku in our own translation, one small practice, and three prompts. From GLOBAL INNER DIVINE, a small studio in Japan.

item.title: Free Guide: 5 Days of Japanese Ideas for Everyday Calm
item.description: A free 5-day guide to Japanese ideas for everyday calm: one idea, one five-minute practice, and one question each day. A printable PDF — no pressure, no noise, just a quiet place to begin. From GLOBAL INNER DIVINE, a small studio in Japan.
